notes.title: The Anniversary Update is HERE!
notes.content:
We’re excited to deliver a massive update that enhances every aspect of the game, making it smoother and more immersive than ever before. Here's a sneak peek at what’s in store:

[b]Fully Optimized Gameplay:[/b]
We've significantly reduced the game’s size from 13GB to just under 7GB without compromising quality. This means faster load times and more efficient performance, all while maintaining the visual and gameplay fidelity you love.

[b]Revamped Environments:[/b]
The entire game world has been reimagined, with reworked environments that provide a more captivating and eerie experience. Prepare yourself for bigger, more expansive areas to explore!

[b]Brand-New Final Cinematic:[/b]
We’ve completely overhauled the final cinematic to deliver an epic and memorable conclusion to your journey. Expect fresh surprises and a more impactful ending!

But that’s not all! In future updates, we’re dialing up the horror with:

[b]Remodeled Enemy Systems:[/b]
Expect more terrifying encounters as we revamp our enemy AI and design. We’re working on making every encounter more challenging and fear-inducing.

[b]New Horrifying Areas:[/b]
We’ll be introducing even more dark and twisted locations for you to explore—each one crafted to test your courage and push the boundaries of survival horror.

[b]And More to Come![/b]
We’re committed to bringing you continuous improvements and fresh content. Stay tuned for even bigger updates as we expand the game's world and features!

We can’t wait for you to experience everything the Anniversary Update has to offer. Thank you for being part of this incredible journey!

Catch you in the game, adventurers!

#AnniversaryUpdate #SurvivalHorror #DarkOceanGames #HorrorUpdate #NewCinematics #TerrifyingEnemies #ExploreTheDarkness

notes.title: MEGA UPDATE 5,0 - Adam's Diary: The Awakening Update
notes.content:
[b][u]Greetings, adventurers![/u][/b]
Your support has been incredible since we launched 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary'. Your feedback has fueled our journey, and today, we're excited to unveil an update that will elevate your gaming experience!

Here's what's new:

[u][b]The Mega Update is finally HERE![/b][/u]
We know you've been eagerly waiting, and we appreciate your patience. One of our developers, Fabio, is still facing serious health issues, requiring extensive treatment and much-needed rest. Despite these challenges we didn't stop and we’re thrilled to deliver a mega update packed with exciting new features!

[b][u]New Areas and Mysteries[/u][/b]
Explore brand new areas filled with fresh mysteries to uncover. Each new location is designed to immerse you deeper into Adam's world and keep you on the edge of your seat.

[u][b]Enhanced Puzzles[/b][/u]
We've added new puzzles that will challenge your wits and provide engaging gameplay. Get ready to think outside the box as you solve these intricate puzzles.

[u][b]Refined Gameplay[/b][/u]
Experience smoother and more precise gameplay with our fine-tuned mechanics. We’ve improved the weapon recoil system to give you that edge in every battle, making every shot count.

[u][b]Polished Gameplay[/b][/u]
The entire gameplay experience has been polished to perfection. From updated sound effects to a better graphics,  every detail has been refined to ensure you have the best possible experience.

[u][b]Upcoming Updates[/b][/u]
Stay tuned for even more exciting features! We're working on introducing a brand new interface and adding support for multiple languages in the next updates, making the game accessible to a broader audience.

[u][b]We're Not Stopping Here![/b][/u]
We're committed to making 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary' even better. Our small team of just two people is hard at work on further improvements to ensure you get the most out of our first game.

[b][u]Exciting Future Ahead[/u][/b]
We're also excited to announce that [b]we’re working on a second game that will be 1000x better[/b]! Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to push the boundaries and deliver an even more epic adventure.

[u][b]Be Part of the Legacy[/b][/u]
Want to see your name featured in 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary'? It's easy! Just shoot an email with your game purchase receipt to info@darkoceangames.com along with your name. Interact with in-game classic consoles and watch the credit screen roll with the names of those who contributed. Due to Fábio's illness, there's been a delay, but names submitted [b]by the end of June will be included in the update coming in July[/b], ensuring your place in gaming history!

[b]So what are you waiting for? Dive back in and let the adventure continue![/b]

Catch you in the game, adventurers!

#AdamsDiary #GameUpdate #SurvivalHorror #DarkOceanGames #ExploreTheDarkness #EnhancedPuzzles

notes.title: Mega Update: 4.0! The Undead Wounds!
notes.content:
[u][b]Hey there, fellow adventurers![/b][/u]

You guys rock! Ever since we dropped 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary', your vibes and feedback have been off the charts. And guess what? Today, we're hyped to bring you an update that's gonna take your gaming experience up a notch!

Check out the latest buzz:

[u][b]The Undead Wounds:[/b][/u]
Now when you blast those zombies, you'll see your shots leaving their mark on those undead bodies! Talk about getting totally sucked into the action, right? It's gonna be epic.
[b]We've fine-tuned the weapon recoil[/b]! So get ready for smoother, more precise gameplay, giving you that edge in every battle.

[u][b] Fresh Interface:[/b][/u]
Say goodbye to the old interface! We've given it a [b]complete overhaul[/b] to make navigating through the game a breeze.

[u][b]Sensitivity is all:[/b][/u]
You can now tweak your mouse sensitivity! Yep, we're all about giving you control, so you can dial in your gaming experience just the way you like it.

[u][b]Eerie Sound Update:[/b][/u]
Several sound effects have been adjusted. Now you'll hear much cleaner sound as you delve into Adam's nightmares.

[b][u]A much cleaner recoil:[/u][/b]
We've overhauled Adam's weapon recoil system entirely. Now you'll feel much more immersed with the updated recoil system.

[u][b]But wait, there's more! You can also become a part of the game's legacy:[/b][/u]
Want to see your name featured in 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary'? It's easy! Just shoot an email with your game purchase receipt to info@darkoceangames.com along with your name. Interact with in-game classic consoles and watch the credit screen roll with the names of those who contributed. And here's the kicker – [b]names submitted by the end of March will be included in the update on March 31, 2024, ensuring your place in gaming history[/b]!

So what are you waiting for? Dive back in and let the adventure continue!

Catch you in the game, adventurers!

notes.title: Mega Update: 3.2! Unleashing Recoil, Illuminating Shadows!
notes.content:
[u][b]Dear Adventurers,[/b][/u]

Your amazing support and feedback since we released 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary' means THE WORLD to us. Today, we're stoked to roll out a big update that's gonna take your game experience to another level!

[u][b]Fixed Intro error:[/b][/u]
This update addresses and resolves any issues or errors that may have occurred during the game's introduction, ensuring a smoother and error-free experience for players.

[u][b]Added Recoil Gun:[/b][/u]
Introducing a new gameplay element, this update brings a recoil system to the weapon in the game. Players can now experience a more realistic and immersive shooting experience as they contend with weapon recoil.

[u][b]Fixed Ending Scene Bug:[/b][/u]
Fixed the bug associated with the final scene, ensuring a smooth and bug-free conclusion to the game.

[b][u]Fixed Painting Room Error:[/u][/b]
Addressing a specific room-related error, this update rectifies any issues or inconsistencies that may have occurred within the painting room, ensuring a more polished and error-free environment.

[b][u]Added More Audio Voices:[/u][/b]
Enriching the auditory experience, this update introduces additional voice lines, enhancing the diversity and depth of the in-game audio. Players can now enjoy a more immersive and varied sound environment.

[b][u]Enemy Remapping:[/u][/b]
This update involves a strategic redesign and placement of enemies within the game. Expect a renewed and possibly more challenging encounter with adversaries as a result of this remapping.

[b][u]Edited Some Interaction Texts:[/u][/b]
Focusing on improving player communication, this update involves revising and refining the text used for in-game interactions. Players can now expect clearer and more polished messaging throughout their gaming experience.

These updates collectively contribute to enhancing the overall gameplay experience, fixing issues, introducing new features, and ensuring a more polished and enjoyable gaming environment.

[b][u]Stay tuned for upcoming updates: New shadow system, game lighting is being completely revamped, graphics are getting a boost, and environments are being overhauled.

THANK YOU SO MUCH for your support![/u][/b]

notes.content:
[u][b]Dear Adventurers,[/b][/u]

Your unwavering support and feedback since the launch of 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary' have been invaluable to us. Today, we're thrilled to present a significant update that takes your gaming experience to new heights!

Prepare for a fresh adventure as some rooms have undergone a complete makeover. Immerse yourself in the revamped environments that bring a new layer of excitement to your journey.

Explore challenging puzzles that have been reimagined for a more engaging experience. The game will be updated with the names of contributors [u]by the end of December.[/u]

We appreciate your understanding as updates are rolled out at a measured pace. Unfortunately, [i][b]one of our developers has been diagnosed with a lung tumor[/b][/i], and we're rallying behind them for a swift recovery. Your continued support means the world to us during this challenging time.

notes.title: Major Game Update: Version 3.0! Immerse Yourself in the Unveiled Changes!
notes.content:
Major Game Update: Version 3.0! Immerse Yourself in the Unveiled Changes!

Dear Adventurers,

Your invaluable feedback since the launch of 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary' has fueled our commitment to enhancing your gaming experience. Today, we're delighted to unveil a major update that promises to elevate your adventure to unprecedented heights!

Revamped Soundscapes:

Prepare for a heightened sensory experience as we've completely overhauled the game's sound effects, including those spine-chilling zombie noises. Feel the atmospheric immersion like never before as you navigate through the eerie auditory landscape.
Diary Pages Illuminated:

We've placed a spotlight on your diary pages, making them more prominent and accessible. Dive into the narrative with ease as crucial details are now highlighted for a clearer understanding of Adam's journey.
Guiding Phrases for Players:

Embark on your journey with newfound clarity as carefully crafted phrases provide subtle guidance. These hints will lead you through the unfolding events, offering valuable insights into the mysteries that surround 'The Midnight Town.'
More updates are on the horizon, and you could even see your name in the game! Stay tuned for exciting announcements and exclusive opportunities.

Thank you for your steadfast support. 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary' was born from the passion of two best friends and a dedicated musician, driven by a shared love for gaming. Despite our initial lack of formal game design experience, our journey has been transformative—a testament to learning, growth, and unwavering dedication.

Share your adventures with us at info@darkoceangames.com and let us know your thoughts on these new changes. Your insights continue to shape the ongoing evolution of the game.

Prepare to confront the unknown once more, and always remember: In the darkest moments, courage shines brightest.

Happy gaming, adventurers!

#AdamsDiary #GameUpdate #SurvivalHorror #DarkOceanGames #ExploreTheDarkness #NewWeapon #EnhancedPuzzles

notes.title: Major Game Update: 2.0! Unleash the Action!
notes.content:
***More updates coming soon. You could have your name in the game and much more. Stay tuned***

Major Game Update: 2.0! Unleash the Action!

Dear Adventurers,

We've been listening closely to your feedback since the release of 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary,' and today, we're thrilled to announce a major update that's set to take your gaming experience to a whole new level!

Enhanced Puzzles:
Your voices have been heard! We've fine-tuned and improved the puzzles to provide a more engaging and rewarding experience. 

Introducing the Gun:
Say goodbye to the trusty old baseball bat! We've armed you with a powerful new tool: a firearm straight out of the pages of a survival horror classic. Feel the adrenaline surge as you take on the darkness with this new addition to your arsenal.

More Monstrous Encounters:
Brace yourself for increased action. The shadows of 'The Midnight Town' now hide even more sinister foes. Face off against new, terrifying adversaries that will test your reflexes and bravery.

Thank you for your unwavering support. 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary' was crafted by two best friends and a musician who share a profound passion for the world of games, despite initially lacking any formal experience in the realm of game design. Our journey has been nothing short of a transformative odyssey—a process of learning, growth, and unwavering dedication to making this game the very best it can be.

Share your experiences with us by email info@darkoceangames.com and let us know what you think of the new changes. We're committed to delivering the best gaming experience possible, and your insights continue to guide us.

Get ready to face the unknown once again, and remember: In the heart of darkness, courage shines brightest.

Happy gaming, adventurers!

notes.title: Major Patch Note - A New Era Unfolds
notes.content:
Major Patch Note - A New Era Unfolds 

Dear Adventurers,

We are thrilled to announce a major update for "Adam's Diary," and it's nothing short of a game-changer! As we approach our debut release this Friday, the entire Dark Ocean Games team is buzzing with excitement, and we can't wait to share the incredible journey we've been on with you.

Revamped AI System:
- Prepare to face a smarter, more challenging enemy AI. We've built it from the ground up to keep you on your toes, and it's not just the regular foes. Stay sharp, as two formidable bosses now await your confrontation.
 
Expanded Scenario Interactions:
- Immerse yourself in the narrative like never before with over 130+ new scenario interactions. 

Polished Environments & Weapon:
- We've combed through every nook and cranny, fixing scenario errors and fine-tuning weapon. The world of "Adam's Diary" is now more polished and ready to welcome you.

Improved UI for Seamless Navigation:
- We've revamped the user interface to make your journey smoother. Easily understand inputs and navigate through the game with confidence.

A Heartwarming Debut:
- Our debut release is almost here, and our hearts are brimming with gratitude for your support. It's been an incredible ride, and we're thrilled to embark on this adventure with you.
We can't express how eager we are to hear what players from around the world think of "Adam's Diary." Your feedback is the compass guiding our future updates and endeavors.

Prepare to unravel the mysteries, confront your deepest fears, and embark on an unforgettable adventure. Get ready for "Adam's Diary."

See you on release day! 

Warm regards,
Dark Ocean Games
